events.title: WildLanterns at Woodland Park Zoo
events.venue: Woodland Park Zoo (West or South Entrance)
events.ageLabel: All ages, except 21+ Night Owls evenings
events.schedule: Nov 13 to Jan 17, 4 to 9pm (last entry 8:30pm), closed some nights
events.priceLabel: See the official page for prices. Members save 20%

registration.note: Tickets are on sale now and sold online only. Members log in at checkout for 20% off. Flex and season passes are also offered. The event runs rain or shine with no refunds.

events.description: Giant glowing lanterns light up the zoo paths after dark. Low-sensory nights fall on Nov 15, Dec 1 and Jan 10. Zoomazium also offers a cozy low-sensory room.
events.sourceNote: Nov 13 2026 to Jan 17 2027 run, 4-9pm hours with last entry 8:30pm, closed evenings (Nov 16-18, 23, 26, 30; Dec 7, 14, 24-25; Jan 4-6, 11-13), low-sensory nights, Night Owls 21+ dates (Nov 20, Dec 18, Jan 2), 20% member discount, flex and season passes and Zoomazium Nightlights (4:30-8:30pm) confirmed on zoo.org/wildlanterns/. On sale since Aug 24 2026, online-only ticketing, rain-or-shine/no refunds and entrance addresses (West 5500 Phinney Ave N, South 750 N 50th St) from the zoo's Aug 24 2026 press release at zoo.org/?p=42753. Ticket prices and infant policy live on the WildLanterns FAQ, which could not be fetched. Sessions list 12 all-ages nights and skip the Nov 20 21+ night. ZIP code and coordinates added from general knowledge.

events.title: Garden d'Lights
events.ageLabel: All ages. Kids 10 and under free
events.schedule: Nov 28 to Jan 3, from 4:30pm nightly, closed Dec 25
events.priceLabel: Kids 10 and under free. Ages 11+ $10, or $5 on value nights

registration.note: Buy tickets online ahead of time. Each ticket is for a set date and a 30-minute entry window. Value nights are Mon to Thu, Nov 30 to Dec 3 and Dec 7 to 10. The Dec 8 sensory-friendly night also needs tickets.

events.description: A winter evening stroll through the botanical garden, lit with holiday light displays. On the Dec 8 sensory-friendly night the lights stay on, the live music is off and crowds are capped.
events.sourceNote: Nov 28 2026 to Jan 3 2027 dates, Dec 25 closure, general nights (first entry 4:30pm, last entry 9pm, lights out 9:30pm), $5 nights Mon-Thu Nov 30-Dec 3 and Dec 7-10 (last entry 8pm, lights out 8:30pm), $10 for ages 11+, 'Kids 10 and under are always free', date- and time-specific online tickets with 30-minute entry windows, and Tuesday Dec 8 sensory-friendly night (all lights, no live music, 200 guests per half-hour, tickets required) confirmed on bellevuebotanical.org/garden-dlights/. No on-sale date is printed. Status open is inferred from the page's 'BUY TICKETS NOW' button. Sensory night start time is not given, so Dec 8 uses the $5-night hours. The page does not say whether free kids need a ticket.

events.title: Winterfest Winter Train & Village
events.venue: Armory Food & Event Hall, Seattle Center
events.schedule: Daily Nov 27 to Dec 31, 10am to 6pm, closed Dec 25
events.priceLabel: Free. $2 suggested donation to run the train

registration.note: No tickets needed. Just drop in. Kids can take a turn at the train controls from 10:30am to 5:30pm for a suggested $2 donation.

events.description: A model train winds through a tiny 19th-century village inside the Armory. The display has been a holiday tradition for nearly 50 years. Grab a scavenger hunt sheet at the train station.
events.sourceNote: Nov 27-Dec 31 2026 run, 10am-6pm daily, Nov 27 open until 8pm, Dec 24 closes 4pm, Dec 25 closed, Armory South Court / Armory Food & Event Hall location, 'Free Event', $2 suggested donation for public turns at the controls, train operation 10:30am-5:30pm, scavenger hunt and nearly-50-year tradition confirmed on the seattlecenter.com event page and the Winterfest featured-events page. Street address is the Seattle Center Armory address shown on seattlechildrensmuseum.org (same building). Sessions are 12 sample days from the daily run, including both shortened days.

events.ageLabel: All ages welcome. Best for ages 3 and up

events.title: Toddler Time at the Seattle Aquarium
events.schedule: Select Sundays and Mondays, 9:30am to noon, through Dec 14
events.priceLabel: Free with admission. Kids 3 and under get in free

registration.note: No reservation is needed. Drop in any time during the program with aquarium admission. Kids 3 and under get in free.

events.description: Themed play mornings for toddlers and their grown-ups. Topics include salmon, shells, Salish Sea whales and winter critters. Stay as long as you like.
events.sourceNote: Select Sundays and Mondays 9:30am-12pm, themed dates Nov 8-9 (Diwali), Nov 15-16 (Salmon Tales), Nov 22-23 (Shells), Nov 29-30 (Whales of the Salish Sea), Dec 6-7 (Winter Critters), Dec 13-14 (Winter Solstice, last of 2026), 'free with Aquarium admission', 'No reservations needed', adult must accompany children, confirmed on the Toddler Time program page ('Dates are subject to change'). 'Kids 3 and under are always free' from the Plan Your Visit page. The aquarium gives no age range, so 12-36 months approximates 'toddlers'.

events.title: Baby Blossoms: Wintry Wiggles
events.ageLabel: 6 months to 2 years, with a caregiver 18+
events.schedule: Tuesdays Nov 10 to Dec 8, 10 to 10:45am, no class Thanksgiving week
events.priceLabel: $125 per session, $100 members. Museums for All 50% off

registration.note: Register online for the whole session. All sales are final and there are no make-up classes. A caregiver must stay for each class.
